claim_judgments.rationale: The claim accurately captures the prohibition against taking off an aircraft with inoperative instruments or equipment unless the conditions in paragraph (a) are met, noting the exception in paragraph (d). All dimensions are faithfully represented.
The claim accurately states the condition under paragraph (a)(1) that an approved Minimum Equipment List must exist for the aircraft, correctly inheriting the governing scope of paragraph (a).

The claim accurately specifies paragraph (a)(2)'s requirement that the aircraft contain a letter of authorization issued by the responsible Flight Standards office authorizing operation under the MEL, within the governing scope of paragraph (a).
The claim accurately captures the permission that the letter of authorization may be obtained by written request of the airworthiness certificate holder.
The claim accurately captures the legal statement that the Minimum Equipment List and the letter of authorization constitute a supplemental type certificate for the aircraft.
The claim faithfully reflects both paragraph (a)(3)(i) and (a)(3)(ii) requirements for the approved MEL under the governing scope of paragraph (a).
The claim correctly reflects paragraph (a)(4)'s requirement regarding aircraft records available to the pilot, maintaining the inherited scope of paragraph (a).
The claim accurately captures paragraph (a)(5)'s condition that the aircraft is operated under all applicable conditions and limitations in the MEL and letter of authorization.
The claim captures all three items in paragraph (b) that may not be included in a Minimum Equipment List, preserving their exact phrasing, conditions, and limitations.
The claim correctly states paragraph (c)'s requirement for authorized persons to use an approved MEL issued under subpart K, part 121, 125, or 135 to comply with section 91.213.

unit_judgments.rationale: Claim C0000 completely and accurately preserves the meaning and scope of paragraph (a).
Claim C0001 completely and accurately preserves the condition in paragraph (a)(1).
Claim C0002 completely and accurately preserves the requirement in paragraph (a)(2) regarding the presence of the letter of authorization.
Claim C0003 completely and accurately preserves the permission in paragraph (a)(2) for obtaining the letter of authorization.
Claim C0004 completely and accurately preserves the statement in paragraph (a)(2) establishing that the MEL and LOA constitute a supplemental type certificate.
Claim C0005 completely covers paragraph (a)(3)(i) requiring the MEL to be prepared in accordance with paragraph (b) limitations.
Claim C0005 completely covers paragraph (a)(3)(ii) requiring the MEL to provide for operating with instruments and equipment in an inoperable condition.
Claim C0006 completely and accurately preserves the requirement of paragraph (a)(4) concerning pilot-available records.
Claim C0007 completely and accurately preserves the requirement of paragraph (a)(5) regarding compliance with MEL and letter conditions.
Claim C0008 faithfully incorporates the exclusion specified in paragraph (b)(1).
Claim C0008 faithfully incorporates the exclusion specified in paragraph (b)(2), including its exception.
Claim C0008 faithfully incorporates the exclusion specified in paragraph (b)(3).
Claim C0009 completely and accurately preserves the duty under paragraph (c).
